# Global support of coded joint plans

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Where configurations a description identifies match parts into configurations it identifies, the leaves are read correctly through it as support, and the parts' footprints lie within the whole's and apart, a plan realized at the description has what its leaves draw on supported, without repetition, by the footprint of every configuration it describes. For a code, the matching follows from compact joints, stable tests and an exact reduced presentation, as in the code form of joint plan lifting.

Canonical source: [JointCorrespondence.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/JointCorrespondence.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Matching of parts through the description (MatchesParts), footprints of parts within the whole's (PartsWithin) and apart (PartsApart), and leaves read correctly as support (Supports); for codes, the matching follows from the premises of joint-code-plan-lifting's code form.

This is formal composition within the same model and leaf interpretation, not a universal adapter to additive budgets or arbitrary temporal models.
